About Sarvam
Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.
About the Role
We are looking for a skilled Backend Engineer to join our Conversational Agents team, building Samvaad — our voice and AI-driven dialogue platform. A day at Samvaad means tackling hard problems, fast feedback, and real impact, all while working with a team that loves tinkering and shipping. You'll design and develop the server-side logic, APIs, and platform orchestration that powers AI conversations for millions of Indians.
What You'll Do
• Build and maintain backend services — scalable APIs (REST/gRPC), fault-tolerant systems, and clean, testable code.
• Design schemas, tune queries (Postgres/NoSQL), manage unstructured data, and apply caching and indexing strategies for performance.
• Deliver reliable releases with full observability — metrics, logs, traces — and ensure backward compatibility.
• Contribute to architecture discussions, resolve scaling and latency bottlenecks, and drive improvements in performance and reliability.
• Champion best practices — enforce coding standards, mentor peers, and stay current with backend and Generative AI technologies.
• Build enterprise-grade software with strong security practices in adherence to privacy and compliance policies.
• Collaborate across teams — integrate models into production, define data contracts with frontend and product, and partner with DevOps for smooth deployments.
What We're Looking For
• 5-8 years of backend development experience, with exposure to distributed systems and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). 
• Demonstrated expertise in Python and Go & Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
• Strong knowledge of SQL (Postgres/MySQL) and NoSQL (Cassandra/ScyllaDB), including schema design, query optimisation, and scaling.
• Experience with message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) or streaming systems.
• Proficiency in algorithms, data structures, and asynchronous programming patterns.
• Experience building and scaling WebSocket/gRPC/WebRTC/REST APIs.
• Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and tracing tools (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry).
• Strong debugging skills with a focus on performance, scalability, and reliability.
• Proven ability to own features end-to-end, review code, and drive process or architecture improvements.
Bonus Points
• End-to-end ownership of the full stack, including frontend technologies such as React, TypeScript, and Next.js.
• Experience setting up CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment.
• Contributions to open-source projects or a strong GitHub portfolio showcasing backend work.
Why Sarvam?
Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.
• Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar
• High ownership and high impact, from day one
• Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems
• You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates
If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

11c210838bed6412.description:
Location: UK. Fully remote, or from our London office next to East Croydon Station
Working pattern: Fully remote working is allowed, and the London office is available to you
Reports to: CTO

About Us
Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.
With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview
You will build the products drivers and car park operators use every day: ANPR camera enforcement, pay-by-web, Autopay, permits, a client console and a motorist account app, across about 160 sites, and the new products we build next. We are a small engineering team, and we form teams around the work from the people we have.
We work in Kotlin on the backend (Spring Boot WebFlux, a domain-driven layering of domain, edge services and repository, Postgres, Axon event sourcing and Pub/Sub) and in TypeScript with Next.js and React on the front end, on GCP and Kubernetes. You do not need to know Kotlin to apply. Our engineers work with AI coding agents day to day, and we are looking for people who use them well and check what they produce.
Every engineer here is product-minded. You will talk to the people who use what you build, decide with product people what is worth building, and find out afterwards whether it worked.
You will report to the CTO and work with a team that reviews each other’s work.

The Mid-level
Mid-level Software Engineer. You own features end to end: you shape them with a product person, build them, test them, release them and look after them once they are live. You work inside an existing architecture with senior review. The work is mostly Kotlin backend plus Next.js and React front end. 

Key Responsibilities
• 
Own the delivery of what you are given, from the first ticket to production, with tests, and be the person who fixes it if it breaks.
• 
Talk to the people who use what you build, and use what you learn to shape and cut scope.
• 
Write acceptance criteria, and check a feature after release to see whether it was used and whether it worked.
• 
Work in our existing codebase and its layering, and keep it consistent for the next engineer.
• 
Use AI coding agents as part of how you work, and be accountable for everything you ship, however it was written.
• 
Take part in the on-call rota and look after what you ship.
• 
Review other engineers’ pull requests, and welcome review of your own.

Who we’re looking for
• 
You’re product-minded. In the last 12 months you’ve talked to real users or customers, and what you learned changed or cut the scope of what you built. You write acceptance criteria, you check a feature after release, and you can say whether something you shipped got used.
• 
You’ve shipped production code end to end in the last 12 months, in any language. You can say what you personally built, and what happened after it went live.
• 
You test as you build. You can describe a bug you shipped and the test that would have caught it.
• 
You use AI coding agents in real work today, and you can describe how you check what they produce, including a time one was wrong.
• 
You’re willing to be on call, and you take ownership of what you ship. You don’t need to have been on call before.
• 
You work well in an existing codebase with a layered or domain-driven structure that you did not design, and you read before you write.
• 
You’re comfortable across the stack. You’ve changed a React or Next.js front end, or worked properly against an API contract, even if you lean backend.
• 
You review others’ pull requests, finding real problems and saying so well, and you change your own design when review shows you a better way.
You do not need a degree, a particular programming language, or Kotlin. Experience of Axon, Temporal, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, parking or payments is welcome, but none of it is required.
This advert is for the Mid-level. If you have more senior experience, see our Senior Software Engineer vacancy here.

What We Offer
• 
Real ownership: mid-level engineers own whole features, and senior engineers own a product area.
• 
A team that works with AI coding agents every day and measures what they do for us.
• 
A strong, high performing culture, with genuine influence over how that culture develops as Hozah grows.
• 
Fully remote working in the UK, with access to a fully refurbished, modern office, right next to East Croydon Station (with a fully stocked kitchen, offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks!).
Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Why Harvey
At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.
 
Role Overview
We’re looking for a Senior People Systems Analyst to own and scale the systems and workflows that support Harvey’s growing global workforce. This role will primarily focus on Workday HCM, owning the design, configuration, testing, and continuous improvement of complex business processes. You’ll also be the go-to systems expert for Benefits and our Applicant Tracking System (Ashby). That means leading feature evaluation, solution design, configuration, root-cause troubleshooting, and end-to-end testing.
You’ll partner closely with People Operations, Benefits, Recruiting, Payroll, Finance, Legal, and Corporate IT to turn business needs into scalable, intuitive, and well-governed system solutions. The ideal candidate is an experienced, hands-on systems professional who works independently from requirements through deployment, brings a clear point of view on how to solve problems, and influences stakeholders toward durable, scalable outcomes.

What You'll Do
• 
Own the configuration, maintenance, and optimization of Workday HCM, including complex business processes, condition rules, approval routing, notifications, security assignments, and worker lifecycle workflows.
• 
Lead solution design end to end: translate ambiguous business needs into system solutions, assess downstream impacts across HCM, Benefits, Payroll, reporting, integrations, and employee experience, and bring recommendations to critical decision points.
• 
Serve as the subject-matter expert for Benefits systems, owning plan configuration, eligibility rules, enrollment workflows, vendor integrations, annual enrollment readiness, issue resolution, and process improvements.
• 
Support Recruiting Systems and administration which includes integrations, and data quality.
• 
Advise senior stakeholders on system capabilities, new features, configuration tradeoffs, and opportunities to simplify or automate manual processes. Explain complex topics clearly and persuasively.
• 
Define and drive testing strategy across Workday, Benefits, Ashby, and connected systems, including workflow, regression, release, and user acceptance testing.
• 
Diagnose complex or unusual system and data issues by tracing configuration, business rules, integrations, and upstream and downstream dependencies. Identify root causes and put durable fixes in place rather than one-off workarounds.
• 
Lead enhancement projects from discovery through deployment with People Operations, Benefits, Recruiting, Payroll, Finance, Legal, and IT, including gathering requirements, documenting options, and prioritizing work.
• 
Set the standard for configuration documentation, test plans, process maps, release notes, and operational procedures that support governance and team self-service.
• 
Proactively monitor system health and data integrity, lead audit and reconciliation support, and uphold security and data governance practices for employee and candidate data.
• 
Lead Workday and vendor release management: evaluate new functionality, assess impact, coordinate testing, and drive adoption decisions.
• 
Act as a resource for peers and stakeholders on complex or challenging systems questions, sharing knowledge and best practices across the team.

What You Have
• 
5+ years of hands-on experience configuring and supporting Workday, an HRIS, or related enterprise business systems.
• 
Deep experience with Workday HCM configuration and the Business Process Framework, including condition rules, approval routing, notifications, security, and workflow design.
• 
Proven ability to independently design and deliver complex, cross-system workflows, using sound judgment to know when a decision needs broader review.
• 
A track record of owning projects that improved workflows, reduced manual effort, or introduced new tools or automation.
• 
Strong experience turning ambiguous business requirements into system solutions, often with limited information, and explaining technical tradeoffs persuasively to non-technical and senior audiences.
• 
Experience defining and running testing strategies, including regression, UAT, defect triage, data validation, and production change management.
• 
Solid working knowledge of Benefits administration or Benefits systems, including eligibility, enrollment, plan configuration, vendor feeds, and annual enrollment.
• 
Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes across systems, processes, integrations, and data.
• 
Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills, adapting your style to different audiences.
• 
Ability to manage competing priorities independently, make well-reasoned recommendations, and operate effectively in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.
Bonus Points
• 
Workday certification or Workday Pro certification in HCM, Benefits, or a related area.
• 
Experience with Workday integrations, EIBs, reports, calculated fields, or APIs.
• 
Experience supporting recruiting system integrations with Workday or other people systems.
• 
Experience with Workday Benefits, Absence, Compensation, Payroll, or Recruiting-related processes.
• 
Experience supporting global HR systems, multiple worker populations, or international expansion.
• 
Experience leading the evaluation and adoption of new Workday or HR technology features.
• 
Experience with security configuration, role-based access, audit readiness, or data governance.
• 
Experience mentoring or guiding other systems analysts or administrators.
• 
Experience working at a high-growth technology company.
 
How You’ll Make an Impact
In this role, you’ll own key parts of Harvey’s people systems foundation and help make sure it is reliable, scalable, and easy to use. You’ll improve the employee and candidate experience by removing manual work, strengthening data quality, and helping People teams operate with greater confidence. Your expertise will shape how HCM, Benefits, and recruiting workflows evolve as Harvey grows, and you’ll set the standards for how we design, test, and govern changes to our systems.

$136,000 - $204,000 USD

1177547a14411b86.description:
Firmable's product depends on customer trust in how we handle their data. This role is the operational backbone of that trust: the controls you run are what let 1,000+ customers rely on Firmable with their data.
The Role
As our Security Engineer, you'll own the day-to-day execution of the security controls and policies that keep Firmable compliant against SOC 2 (all five TSC) and ISO 27001:2022. You'll report into the Security & Compliance team, fully remote and open globally. This is a hands-on operational role, not a paper-compliance one: you implement, monitor and continuously tighten the controls auditors and customers actually test against.
~90% hands-on execution: control implementation, continuous monitoring, evidence collection, vulnerability and access management.
~10% cross-functional: partnering with engineering on secure cloud config and shaping the program as it scales across frameworks.
What You'll Own

• 
SOC 2 & ISO 27001 execution: implement and maintain controls across infrastructure, applications and internal systems; close gaps as they're identified

• 
Security policy enforcement: put information security policy into daily practice across engineering and business teams, covering access control, data classification, incident response, vendor risk and change management

• 
Continuous control monitoring: recurring access reviews, log reviews, vulnerability scans and patch cadence checks; organise evidence ahead of audits

• 
Vulnerability management: triage scanner findings, coordinate remediation with engineering, verify closure

• 
Identity & access management: onboarding/offboarding, least-privilege and MFA enforcement, periodic access recertification

• 
Monitoring & incident response: watch security alerts and logs, triage and escalate per the incident response plan

• 
Risk & vendor management: maintain the risk register and third-party risk assessments, track remediation to closure

• 
Audit readiness: prepare evidence for annual assessments and respond to customer security questionnaires

• 
Security awareness: run employee training and phishing simulations

• 
Secure cloud configuration: partner with engineering on least-privilege IAM, encryption at rest and in transit, and secrets management (AWS)

What We're Looking For
Must haves

• 
2–5 years in security engineering, cloud security or infrastructure security, ideally with direct SOC 2 or ISO 27001 exposure

• 
Working knowledge of the SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria and how technical controls map to them

• 
Hands-on cloud security fundamentals (AWS preferred): IAM, logging/monitoring, vulnerability scanning

• 
Comfortable executing policy day to day (access reviews, evidence collection, remediation tracking), not just writing it

• 
Clear written communication and comfortable working async across time zones with a distributed team

Highly valued

• 
Familiarity with GRC automation platforms (Vanta, Drata or similar)

• 
Relevant certification (Security+, CySA+, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, or progress toward CISA/CISSP)

The Environment
Fully remote, open globally, working closely with a distributed Security and Engineering team across time zones. Real ownership over controls that directly protect customer trust, not a box-ticking exercise. Fast-moving, AI-native product team.
Why This Role

• 
Real ownership: the controls you run directly protect the trust 1,000+ customers place in Firmable's data

• 
Multi-framework exposure from day one: a live SOC 2 and ISO 27001 program, not a single-framework box-tick

• 
Competitive compensation and flexible hours in a fast-moving, AI-native product team

You’ll join the Premium Growth India team within the Markets & Subscriptions organisation, responsible for converting free users into Premium subscribers and keeping them there. Sitting at the intersection of strategy, marketing, product, and data, the team works to sustainably grow Spotify’s Premium subscriber base in India.

In this role, you’ll drive demand capture and retention for Premium India by localising global strategies, developing India-specific initiatives, and executing across conversion funnels, offers, lifecycle programs, and win-back initiatives. You’ll collaborate with global and regional Growth teams as well as local Marketing and Music teams, while owning execution and experimentation in India.

What You’ll Do
• 

Localise and execute the Premium demand capture strategy for India, adapting global frameworks and developing India-specific offer strategies and organic conversion opportunities in collaboration with global and regional Growth teams.

• 

Drive programs that reduce voluntary and involuntary churn, anticipating retention risks and developing initiatives to retain and win back users.

• 

Own CRM execution using in-house tools to build, manage, and optimise communication journeys across email, push, and in-app channels to improve conversion and retention.

• 

Develop and test new conversion and retention approaches, bringing fresh thinking to how we turn free users into Premium subscribers and keep them engaged.

• 

Analyse conversion and retention data to identify funnel drop-offs and cohort-specific opportunities, translating insights into clear recommendations and business cases.

• 

Design and run A/B tests and experiments across the funnel and CRM channels to improve conversion and subscriber lifetime value.

• 

Collaborate with Marketing to connect conversion programs with top-of-funnel activity and key brand moments, and partner with Finance to model offer economics, forecast subscriber growth, and evaluate investment returns.

Capture and share learnings that strengthen the Premium Growth playbook, contribute to global best practices, and support cross-regional Growth initiatives when business priorities require it.

• 

Integrate AI-driven tools and workflows thoughtfully to improve decision-making and execution efficiency.

Who You Are
• 

You have 3+ years of experience in growth, CRM, lifecycle marketing, conversion optimisation, or a related area within a digital consumer business such as streaming, e-commerce, fintech, gaming, or media.

You have hands-on CRM and lifecycle marketing experience, including building and optimising communication journeys and managing campaign calendars across channels such as email, push, and in-app messaging.

You are comfortable working with large datasets and understand how to ask the right analytical questions, interpret data, and turn insights into decisions.

You combine creative and analytical thinking, approaching problems from different angles while using rigorous funnel analysis to reach actionable conclusions.

• 

You take initiative and ownership, proactively identifying opportunities and moving solutions forward.

• 

You work effectively across functions and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, collaborating with partners across Product, Data, Marketing, Finance, and other teams to influence shared outcomes.

Where You’ll Be
• 

This role is based in Mumbai

• 

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
